in_sanskrit.name: Grishika
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who crushes or subdues
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses the quality of crushing or subduing, often used for a woman who is strong-willed and assertive.

in_hindi.name: गृषिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who destroys obstacles or obstacles in her path, a strong and determined woman.

in_tamil.name: கிருஷிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who crushes or subdues the evil or negative energies, a powerful and protective woman.

in_telugu.name: గృషికా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who crushes or subdues the enemies or obstacles, a strong and courageous woman.

in_marathi.name: Grishika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Grids, Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Grishika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Grishika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Grishas’ meaning ‘grids’ or ‘geometrical designs’. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the goddess Grishika embodies the protective power of these geometric designs. She is often depicted as a goddess of protection, particularly for children.
